positive_boundary: Sarthi may help distinguish an immediate affected-person need from deferrable work, choose one reversible next action, communicate the trade-off, and protect a later review point. The user's stated facts establish priority; scripture supplies optional lenses rather than assigning universal family roles.

principles.application_boundary: The passage does not identify which present action is necessary. That depends on affected people, urgency, reversibility, alternatives, and the user's real obligations; it cannot justify gendered or unlimited care demands.
principles.en: When one need is genuinely time-sensitive, choose the necessary action available now rather than becoming paralysed by competing demands. First establish necessity from the situation, not from a generic label such as work or family.
principles.hi: जब कोई आवश्यकता वास्तव में समय-संवेदनशील हो, तो प्रतिस्पर्धी माँगों से जड़ होने के बजाय अभी उपलब्ध आवश्यक कर्म चुनें। आवश्यकता को पहले परिस्थिति से तय करें—केवल ‘काम’ या ‘परिवार’ जैसे सामान्य नाम से नहीं।

principles.application_boundary: Balance is not a fixed schedule, a clinical prescription, or a reason to ignore urgent care. It includes the sustainability of the caregiver as a material constraint.
principles.en: A sustainable pattern gives due place to effort, restoration, food, movement, and sleep. Use this as a reminder to repair the wider pattern after the immediate need, not as a demand to optimise every moment.
principles.hi: टिकाऊ क्रम में प्रयास, विश्राम, भोजन, गतिविधि और नींद को उचित स्थान मिलता है। इसे तत्काल आवश्यकता के बाद व्यापक दिनचर्या सुधारने की याद मानें—हर क्षण को अधिकतम उत्पादक बनाने की माँग नहीं।

principles.application_boundary: Gentle speech must not conceal a missed obligation, unsafe staffing, coercion, or another material fact. The aim is honest coordination, not avoidance.
principles.en: Communicate the immediate constraint truthfully, usefully, and without needless agitation: name what has changed, what you can still do, and when you will review the postponed work.
principles.hi: तत्काल बाधा को सत्य, उपयोगी और अनावश्यक उत्तेजना से बचते हुए बताएँ: क्या बदला है, आप अभी क्या कर सकते हैं और टाले गए काम की समीक्षा कब करेंगे।

principles.application_boundary: Considered choice does not make all options equivalent and does not remove obligations to dependants, safety, law, employment, or other affected people.
principles.en: After considering the whole situation, retain responsibility for the choice. Use a review point so today's necessary priority does not silently become an indefinite pattern.
principles.hi: पूरी परिस्थिति पर विचार के बाद चुनाव की जिम्मेदारी अपने पास रखें। समीक्षा-बिन्दु तय करें ताकि आज की आवश्यक प्राथमिकता चुपचाप अनिश्चितकालीन क्रम न बन जाए।

required_context: which affected person's need is time-sensitive
which work or household tasks can safely be deferred
what communication, backup support, or deadline constraint exists
when the temporary prioritization will be reviewed

en: Identify the non-deferrable affected-person need from stated facts.
Choose one reversible present action and explicitly defer only safe tasks.
Communicate the change and preserve a review point.
Check caregiver sustainability without assigning duty by gender or praising self-neglect.
hi: बताए गए तथ्यों से प्रभावित व्यक्ति की न टाली जा सकने वाली आवश्यकता पहचानें।
अभी का एक उलट सकने योग्य कदम चुनें और केवल सुरक्षित कामों को स्पष्ट रूप से टालें।
बदलाव की सूचना दें और समीक्षा-बिन्दु बनाए रखें।
लिंग के आधार पर कर्तव्य तय किए या आत्म-उपेक्षा की प्रशंसा किए बिना देखभालकर्ता की टिकाऊ क्षमता जाँचें।

scope: A bounded bilingual conversation route for a work-and-care conflict where the user has identified an immediate dependent-person need and stated that the competing work can safely be deferred.
